title: Chicken in soy-based sauce with rice and vegetables, frozen meal

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken in soy-based sauce with rice and vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal containing bite‑size chicken breast pieces cooked in a soy sauce, steamed rice, and a mix of carrots, broccoli and peas. It is designed for quick reheating in a microwave or on the stovetop.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy sauce gives the dish its characteristic umami flavor and adds a small amount of protein and minerals.
Chicken breast is a lean source of highly digestible protein, ideal for active lifestyles.
The vegetable blend provides vitamins B, C and dietary fiber.
The meal can be stored in the freezer for up to 12 months without quality loss.
Typical reheating time is 3–5 minutes in a microwave.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Chicken supplies about 20 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Lean chicken breast keeps the overall fat content low, suitable for reduced‑fat diets.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals from vegetables
items.content: Broccoli and carrots deliver vitamin C, vitamin K, folate and potassium.

items.title: Energy from rice
items.content: Steamed rice provides complex carbohydrates that release energy gradually.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: The meal contains no added sugars, making it appropriate for blood‑glucose control.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Soy sauce can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Soy sauce contributes salt; people limiting sodium should monitor portion size.

items.title: Need for thorough heating
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave live bacteria; heat to an internal temperature of 75 °C.

items.title: Gluten in soy sauce
items.content: Some soy sauces contain wheat; choose a gluten‑free version if you have celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Microwave the frozen meal on high (800 W) for 3–5 minutes, stir, and let stand for 1–2 minutes. Optionally garnish with fresh scallions or a squeeze of lime for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C or lower. Once thawed, consume within 2 hours at room temperature.
